how: Evaluate each calc against the LOCAL custom function and compare the result to expect as text. A file running a stale definition fails regardless of the version it claims.

vectors.asserts: auto kind overwrites an existing text key and leaves siblings untouched
auto kind keeps a number a number
auto kind keeps a boolean a boolean; value 0 becomes false
TYPE-PRESERVATION GUARD — a text "14" stays text under auto and is not coerced to a number
an explicit kind overrides the inferred type — force number onto a text-stored value
a brand-new key under auto has no existing type and lands as text
ENCODING GUARD — explicit boolean 0 is JSON false. Fails if the not-equal operator was transcoded.
explicit boolean coerces any non-zero value to true
json kind attaches raw nested JSON rather than stringifying it
non-destructive across a mixed-type object — one key overwritten, the other keys and their types intact
